tracks.info: 10mm-tall plain track. Lowest standard height — extreme low profile for aggressive attack.
10.5mm plain track. The default low-profile track for attack-focused builds.
13mm mid-low track. Used in Fang Leone — adds stability without losing attack potential.
13.5mm mid track. Balanced height for stamina and balance combos.
14.5mm standard mid track. The most common height across the trilogy — defense-leaning.

tracks.name: C145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with retractable claws. Limits rebound angle — niche pick for stamina under pressure.

tracks.name: ED145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with a free-spinning ring on top. Deflects descending attacks. Pure defense.

tracks.name: GB145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with built-in ball weights that shift mass outward. Stamina booster.

tracks.name: W105
tracks.info: 10.5mm with downward-angled wings. Adds aerodynamic stamina to a low-profile build.

tracks.name: LW105
tracks.info: 10.5mm with sharper wing protrusions for left-spin smash. Used in Meteo L-Drago.

tracks.name: D125
tracks.info: 12.5mm with side-shield armor. Adds stability and lateral defense.

tracks.name: AD145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with armored side ring. Heavy-defense pick.

tracks.name: BD145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with a detachable boost disk. Adds mass when locked in.

tracks.name: SW145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with switchable height modes. Versatile across builds.

tracks.name: Horn 145
tracks.info: 14.5mm with bull-horn protrusions. Aggressive defense — rebounds attackers.
